title: The 5 Longest Ships Ever Built, Ranked (#1 Is a Floating Gas Factory)

scenes.text: The five longest ships ever built, ranked. Number one is a floating gas factory.

scenes.label: Barzan · 400 m
scenes.text: Number five: Barzan, a container ship. Four hundred meters long, about four football fields end to end.

scenes.label: Esso Atlantic · 406 m
scenes.text: Number four: Esso Atlantic, an oil tanker. Four hundred and six meters, longer than the Eiffel Tower is tall.

scenes.label: Batillus · 414 m
scenes.text: Number three: Batillus, one of four sister supertankers. Four hundred and fourteen meters of steel hull.

scenes.label: Seawise Giant · 458 m
scenes.text: Number two: Seawise Giant, a tanker. Four hundred and fifty-eight meters long, and broken up in 2010.

scenes.label: Prelude · 488 m
scenes.text: Number one: Prelude, a floating gas platform. Four hundred and eighty-eight meters, longer than the Empire State Building is tall.

description:
The five longest ships ever built, ranked by length overall.
From the container ship Barzan to Prelude, a floating gas platform nearly half a kilometer long.
What is the biggest ship you have ever seen in person?
first_comment: Which giant machine should we rank next? Tell us what to measure.
